title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.13 re-checks every fix shipped since 1.42.3 against the code and completes the ones that had a hole: a Remove All that still read the disk, a Java import without its semicolon, a header rule that lost the import block behind a multi-line file annotation, a catalog lookup defeated by a space in the path, and a few more.

highlights.title: Remove All reads what you see
highlights.description: Since 1.42.11 the corpus took its offsets from open editors, but Remove All still read the disk copy, so a deletion in a file being edited landed lines off. Both read the document now, and a Java @VisibleForTesting import finally ends with its semicolon.

highlights.title: Import block behind @file:Suppress(
highlights.description: The 1.42.9 header rule stopped at a multi-line file annotation: Organize Imports did nothing, unused imports lost their graying, Add import landed above the block. Version catalogs are also keyed by path, so a space in the project directory no longer defeats the per-project lookup.

highlights.title: Web parity completed
highlights.description: Corpus invalidation on save, the live status bar counter, clearing a detector's warnings and the file cap warning reach vscode.dev too. The Java outline stays complete while typing, the hex swatches follow the active editor in a split, and autoOpen: false no longer opens the vector preview.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Leaves the Logcat device alone while it is briefly offline instead of switching to the first ready one and emptying the buffer.
Recognises Java method headers behind annotations with arguments, and no longer reads case RED -> as a lambda binding.

Opens the online documentation page when its tab is shown rather than on the Cmd+hover preview, removes a manifest component from the android:name line, and keeps soft-wrapped Logcat rows across an append.
